at_version: not specified by APG select-only example
behavior: APG keeps DOM focus on the non-input combobox and moves accessibility focus through aria-activedescendant; the example explicitly warns that AT support gaps require production testing.
source_date: living document; no publication date shown
decision: Use APG trigger focus plus aria-activedescendant and an adjacent controlled listbox; keep native select as the touch-preferred alternative.

behavior: A published editable-combobox result reports no support for conveying aria-haspopup=listbox in this pair. It is not a select-only test and does not prove active-descendant failure.
decision: Do not rely on popup-type announcement: expose expanded state, option name, selected state, and position through the combobox/listbox contract.

at_version: version not stated; issue confirmed on Android 12-14
behavior: APG 2855 reports that users cannot navigate into or choose from the expanded select-only listbox; the issue remained confirmed on 2025-06-13 and its precise cause was not established.
decision: Prefer native select on Android; a custom fallback must use an inline adjacent listbox and cannot ship on desktop evidence alone.

behavior: WebKit 231724 originally reported missing active-descendant option announcements; a later comment reports the original case working in Safari 18.4/macOS 15.4.1, not universal current support.
decision: Use APG active-descendant with an adjacent listbox; verify actual active-option speech and do not claim a fixed version from one comment.

at_version: version not stated in WebKit 289338; current version pending
browser_version: not stated in WebKit 289338; current version pending
behavior: WebKit 289338 reports VoiceOver skipping a listbox mounted at the end of body despite aria-controls and aria-activedescendant, while the inline comparison works.
decision: Prefer native select on iOS; if custom interaction is mandatory, render the listbox inline/adjacent rather than in a remote top-layer portal.
